name: Levanter
description: Deploy the Levanter WhatsApp bot on Heroku. Deploy setup by AHMED X.

SESSION_ID.description: Your Levanter session ID. Get it from the Levanter session site.

SUDO.description: Admin numbers that can control the bot, separated by commas.

PREFIX.description: Command prefix, for example a dot.

ALWAYS_ONLINE.description: Show the bot number as always online (true/false).

STICKER_PACKNAME.description: Sticker pack name shown on stickers the bot makes.

WARN_LIMIT.description: Maximum warnings before action in groups.

HEROKU_APP_NAME.description: This app's own name on Heroku (only needed for the bot's Heroku self-management features).

HEROKU_API_KEY.description: Heroku API key (only needed for the bot's Heroku self-management features).
